items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:45:1
items.html:
Tifferet, and when the light reached its upper third, which is up to the Chazeh [chest], then it drew the generality of the five Hassadim into the Yesod of Aba and the generality of the five Gevurot into the Yesod of Ima: As written above, that when the screen of phase two refined — after the breaking of the vessel of the king of Gevura — to phase one, which is the level of ZA, then the generality of the five Hassadim and the five Gevurot was revealed in the Yesodot of AVI. And from above downward the light reached the fourth king, which is the upper third of Tifferet, up to the Chazeh.
However, we must understand the matter of this generality of the five Hassadim and five Gevurot that is in the Yesod of Aba and Ima — what they mean. You will understand the matter from what is brought in the Zohar, that Ima expands only until Hod, but she has no Yesod. The matter is that the ARI already wrote in Part 5 (page 315, item 33), concerning Mati [reaching] and Lo Mati [not reaching], that in the second expansion the light of Hochma comes into the vessel of Keter, and the light of Bina into the vessel of Hochma, until the light of Malchut is in the vessel of Yesod, and Malchut herself remained without light. Thus we find that the screen of phase one, which brought out the level of the light of Hassadim, expanded only as far as Hod, and there it refined to the discernment of the root, and the level of Malchut came out upon it, and this light of Malchut clothed in the vessel of Yesod, as is written there at length in the Inner Light (page 336, the passage beginning “It returned”), and see there, for it is impossible to bring that whole elaboration here. It therefore turns out that the light of Yesod is the discernment of Hochma in the absence of Hassadim, for all the VAK [six ends] came out there through Ima, in the illumination of Hochma within Hassadim; and after the screen of phase one refined, the illumination of Hochma alone remained, without any Hassadim. And this is the secret of “Ima expands only until Hod,” for the whole discernment of Ima is only the light of Hassadim, and since the Hassadim have become concealed she has no further expansion with which to shine in the vessel of Yesod. But Aba, who is the secret of the light of Hochma, is found still shining in Yesod. And this is the secret of “the Yesod of Aba is long and narrow,” for he expands further than Ima: the whole illumination of Ima has already ceased at Hod, but Aba still shines to Yesod, which is the light of Malchut, as above.
Now this illumination of Aba that is in the vessel of Yesod is regarded as the discernment of the five Gevurot, as written there in the Inner Light, and this is because of the lack of Hassadim there. It is for this reason that the Yesod of Aba is narrow, from the force of the Gevurot of the blockage from Hassadim. Accordingly you will understand that after the screen refined from phase two to phase one — which means that the bottom Hey rose once again to the Einayim, which are phase one of the Rosh — then Bina was again included in Malchut, and therefore the five Gevurot of the light of Malchut that is in the vessel of Yesod were again included in her, as above (page 500, the passage beginning “Above”). And this is what he says, “that it drew the generality of the five Hassadim into the Yesod of Aba and the five Gevurot into the Yesod of Ima” — that is, because of the rise of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, whereby they returned back to back once more, and the Hassadim of Aba lack GAR [first three] because of the bottom Hey that is in the Einayim, and this is the secret of the generality of the five Hassadim that is in the Yesod of Aba. And Ima was included from the light of Malchut that is in the vessel of Yesod, which is the illumination of Hochma without Hassadim.
As for why they are called the generality of the five Hassadim and five Gevurot, and not simply the five Hassadim and five Gevurot, it is because it is known that the root of everything is the five known phases, KHB ZON. However, they are discerned in three root manners, which are in the relation of Rosh, Toch and Sof: the five phases from the side of the light of Hochma itself are called KHB ZON; the five phases from the side of the light of Hassadim, in the illumination of Hochma, are called HGT, Netzah and Hod; and the discernment of the light of the illumination of Hochma without Hassadim is called simply the five Gevurot. And the discernment of Hassadim that lack GAR, or discernments of Gevurot that are protected in the posterior of Ima but are essentially lacking GAR — as here, where the bottom Hey is in the Einayim, above Bina — are likewise regarded as the generality of the five Hassadim or the generality of the five Gevurot. Remember this.
And still we must understand the matter of the division of the vessel of Tifferet into two halves, which we have not found in any Sefira. The matter is that it is known that the three vessels Hesed, Gevura and Tifferet are the discernment of GAR — Keter, Hochma, Bina — except that since they are discernments of the light of Hassadim they are called HGT. Accordingly it turns out that the vessel of Tifferet is the discernment of Bina. Now the Sefira of Bina is discerned in two discernments: the first is called the upper Bina, and the second is called Tevuna. The reason for her division is that it was explained above (page 507, the passage beginning “They can”) that the Bina of direct light is light of Hassadim without Hochma at all; on the contrary, she rejects Hochma because she desires Hassadim more, in the secret of “for He desires mercy.” Study it there well. However, at the time she emanated ZON of direct light, she returned face to face with Hochma in order to draw the illumination of Hochma to ZON of direct light. Study it there well. Thus there are two states in the Bina of direct light: the first, before she emanated ZON, when she is in the light of Hassadim with her posterior toward Hochma; and the second, after she emanated ZON, when she is already in the discernment of face to face with Hochma, in order to draw the illumination of Hochma to her children, who are ZON. Therefore these two states divide the Bina of direct light into two discernments that are distinct from one another: the first is called Bina, or the upper Ima, and the second is called Tevuna.
Now you will thoroughly understand the matter of the division of Tifferet into two halves at the Chazeh, for it is precisely the matter of the division of Bina: from the Chazeh upward is the discernment of the upper Ima, whose posterior is toward Hochma and who chooses Hassadim, as above, in the secret of “for He desires”; and from the Chazeh downward is the discernment of Tevuna, whose face is toward Hochma and who has the illumination of Hochma, as above.
And this is what he says, “and when the light reached its upper third, which is up to the Chazeh,” etc. For after AVI returned back to back, and the coupling was made upon the screen that had risen to the light of the Einayim and brought out a level of phase one, which is protected in the posterior of Ima that reject Hochma, as above — the light of this level, which expanded from above downward to the Guf [body], to the vessel of Tifferet, was unable to expand there any further than the upper third of Tifferet, that is, up to the Chazeh. For there is the part of Tifferet that is drawn from the upper Ima, in the discernment of the light of Hassadim and with the posterior toward Hochma. But in the part of Tifferet that is from the Chazeh downward, there is the discernment of Tevuna, which draws the illumination of Hochma for the sake of ZON, as above. Therefore the light of the posterior of the upper Ima cannot come and expand there, since it has already ceased at the Chazeh.

items.html:
When the light reached the two lower thirds of Tifferet, then all the posterior of the upper AVI finished descending: That is to say, the whole illumination of the Partzuf of the upper AVI has already ceased, and they cannot shine from the Chazeh downward, not even their back to back lights, for they cease at the Chazeh, as above, in the adjacent item.
Now it has been explained that the light of the Sefira of Hesed is entirely the discernment of the body of Aba; the light of the Sefira of Gevura is the discernment of the body of Ima; and the light of the upper third of Tifferet is the discernment of the Yesodot of AVI. And know that the matter of the drawing of the two bodies of AA to the place of these three Sefirot is with complete precision, for that is their place according to the relation of the vessels. For you know that the three vessels Hesed, Gevura and Tifferet are the discernment of KHB of Hassadim. You also know that the whole level of the Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] of Nekudim is drawn through the coupling of AB SAG, and it is considered a level of AB, as above (page 517, the passage beginning “And although”). And it is known that in AB the light of Hochma clothes in the vessel of Keter, the light of Bina in the vessel of Hochma, and the light of ZA in the vessel of Bina. Therefore here too the body of Aba, which is the light of Hochma, clothed in the vessel of Hesed, which is the discernment of Keter of Hassadim; and the body of Ima, which is the light of Bina, in the vessel of Gevura, which is the discernment of Hochma of Hassadim; and the body of the Yesodot of AVI, which is the level of ZA, clothed in the upper third of Tifferet, which is the discernment of the upper Ima of Hassadim. And it could not expand into the two lower thirds of Tifferet, for there is the discernment of Tevuna of Hassadim, and therefore it ceased at the Chazeh, as above. Thus every light comes in precise correspondence to its own vessel among the five phases of the light of Hassadim. Understand this well. And this is what he says, “and we have already explained this image, that Daat includes the Reisha [head] of AVI, Hesed is the body of Aba, Gevura is the body of Ima, and the upper third of Tifferet is the Yesod of AVI” — that is, as was explained, that the three vessels HGT are the discernment of GAR of the five phases of Hassadim, and therefore they too are the ones that receive from the upper AVI; and of the vessel of Tifferet, only its upper third belongs to GAR, since from the Chazeh downward it is already the discernment of Tevuna, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:45:3
items.html:
And it drew Hesed and Gevura into the Reishin [heads] of YESHSUT, for that is the place of their Rosh together: For the screen refined further, from phase one to the discernment of the root and to the discernment of the screen of the Rosh, and it was then included there in the coupling of the Rosh, in the manner explained regarding the previous Partzufim [pl. of Partzuf] (as written in the Inner Observation, page 455, item 16. See there). And the coarseness returned upon the screen, except for the last phase in it, which is phase three, of which nothing remained but the discernment of clothing alone (as written there in item 14). Therefore there remained in it only phase two together with phase three of clothing, which are male and female, and two levels came out upon them, which are the level of Hochma of the male and the level of Bina of the female. And the essence of the level is the measure of the female, which is phase two, as written there, for the discernment of Hochma has no coarseness by which it could expand from above downward. And this level is called YESHSUT, and it is the son and the lower one of the upper AVI.
And this is what he says, “and it drew Hesed and Gevura into the Reishin of YESHSUT,” for a level of phase two came out there upon the screen from below upward, in the Peh [mouth] of the Rosh of AVI. And when the coarseness of the Guf that is in the screen became recognized, it is regarded as having descended to the place of the Guf of AVI, that is, to the place of the Chazeh of the Guf. And it brought out ten Sefirot of Rosh from the Chazeh upward to the Peh of AVI, and from the Chazeh downward their ten Sefirot of Guf came out, that is, in the place of the two lower thirds of Tifferet. And this is what he says, “for that is the place of their Rosh together,” meaning that from the place of the Chazeh up to the Peh is the place of their Rosh, just as was explained regarding the previous Partzufim (see page 454 in the Inner Observation, in all fourteen operations of the birth of a Partzuf, for it is impossible to bring here the whole elaboration that is there).
And remember what we explained above concerning the difference between AVI and YESHSUT, which stems already from the side of the Bina of direct light, who divides into two discernments: the first, before she emanated ZON of direct light, when she is only Hassadim without Hochma; and the second, after she emanated ZON of direct light, when she is face to face with Hochma, since she must draw the illumination of Hochma for the sake of ZON. Therefore the ten Sefirot of Bina are discerned as dividing into GAR and ZAT, her KHB being the discernment of the upper half of Bina, of the discernments of Hassadim without Hochma, and her ZON being considered the lower half of Bina, which is in the illumination of Hochma. So that YESHSUT, which is the discernment of the lower half of Bina, is considered the ZAT of Bina, that is, her discernment of ZON. And they cannot be without Hochma, for their whole essence is the illumination of Hochma, as above with ZON (page 513, the passage beginning “MAN”). Therefore only YESHSUT is considered the Rosh to ZON, for from the moment that Bina drew the illumination of Hochma for the sake of ZON she is considered the discernment of Tevuna, as above, and not the discernment of the upper Ima, since the upper Ima is discerned only before she brought out ZON. And remember well this difference between Bina and Tevuna at their source, for you will need it in all places.
And you should not object that here the upper AVI were the Rosh to ZON, since their Guf clothed in the HGT of ZA, as above. The matter is that in truth AVI together with YESHSUT are considered one Partzuf, GAR and ZAT, as above, and the matter of their division comes about through the rise of the bottom Hey to the Einayim. Therefore, since through the coupling of face to back the bottom Hey descended from the Einayim, as above, the two of them joined into one Partzuf, this being through the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] that AVI received from the Yesod of AK, in which they are face to face, as above. And therefore the upper Ima too received the illumination of Hochma into her ZAT, which are now likewise considered the discernment of the upper Ima. But now, after the screen has once again refined to phase one and the bottom Hey has returned to the Einayim, as above, AVI and YESHSUT have again divided into two Partzufim, and now the upper Ima is once more discerned as the discernment of Hassadim without Hochma, that is, only the discernment of back to back, as above. And the matter of the illumination of Hochma does not pertain to her, but to the ZAT that have now become a separate Partzuf, which is YESHSUT, as above. From here onward only YESHSUT is considered the Rosh to ZON, and not the upper AVI. And you will understand and see that even at the time when they were one Partzuf, before the bottom Hey rose to the Einayim, when the upper AVI were still the Rosh of ZON, even so they bestowed only upon the HGT of ZA, which in truth, from the side of the vessels, are in the relation of KHB of Hassadim, and not upon the essence of ZON; for the essence of ZON from the side of Hassadim are Netzah and Hod, since Netzah is ZA and Hod is Malchut, as above. Therefore they could receive only from the Rosh of YESHSUT. So that the GAR of AVI, that is, the upper AVI joined with the ZAT in one Partzuf, bestowed upon the GAR of Hassadim; and the ZAT of AVI, after they had divided from them and become a separate Partzuf by the name of YESHSUT, bestowed upon the ZAT of Hassadim, which are NH, who are the ZON of Hassadim, as explained.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:45:4
items.html: The Hassadim descended from the Reisha of Israel Saba and the Gevurot from the Reisha of Tevuna, down below into the body: For after the vessel of Tifferet that is from the Chazeh downward died, the screen of phase three, which is included from the female, refined, and then the level of Hochma in them became concealed, and the five Hassadim and the five Gevurot descended from the Reishin of YESHSUT to the discernment of Guf of YESHSUT. That is to say, the coupling was made upon the remainders of the coarseness that remained in the screen, which is phase two, which brings out the level of Bina, and that level is considered the discernment of Guf with respect to the level of Hochma. However, this does not mean an actual discernment of Guf, which is from above downward, for the whole of YESHSUT is the discernment of Rosh, that is, the discernment of from below upward; and their Guf is the TNHYM of Nekudim, as the ARI writes here.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:45:5
items.html: The discernment of the looking of their eyes at one another was diminished from them: It has already been explained above that the level of the inclusion of the female in the male, which here is the level of phase three of clothing, is called the looking of their eyes at one another, which is the matter of their inclusion in one another. And this level of Hochma expanded only in the vessel of Tifferet, from its Chazeh downward, as above. The reason is that the vessel of Tifferet is the discernment of Bina of Hassadim, and it is still considered the discernment of GAR among the vessels of Hassadim; therefore the great light of YESHSUT clothed only in it, and not in the vessels of NH, which even from the side of Hassadim are likewise the discernment of ZAT, being the ZON of Hassadim, as above. And you know this, that the light drawn to a Partzuf always clothes in the most refined vessel, the one that is most similar to it in equivalence of form.
